_comment: FR session courier config. Canonical stationmaster-courier shape (flat, single hub), NOT the old ghost-bridge v2 multi-pair shape. Copy to fr-courier.config.json and fill ssh_target with the real hub address. fr-courier-daemon.py wraps stationmaster-courier.py and adds per-agent routing (default_inbox) + session lifecycle.
_routing_note: Inbound is routed per-agent on entry.to with three guards (present + name-hygiene + inbox-file-already-exists). default_inbox (team-lead) is the fallback when any guard fails. target_inbox is retained for reference-courier compatibility and as the inject_batch working field; default_inbox is what FR routing actually falls back to.
_outbox_note: ghost_outboxes is the list of session-less local inbox names our agents SendMessage to for OUTBOUND mail. apex-bridge -> apex per the <name>-bridge convention. Add more bridge outboxes here as cross-team routes open; multi-destination fan-out from a single generic outbox is an undefined protocol extension (do not rely on it).
